snippet.description:
Confused about what to do next in your UPSC preparation? Need a strategy that is actually personalised to your situation?

Join the UPSC Mentorship Session with Sonia Gupta, Head of Mentorship Program at LevelUp IAS, who has appeared for the UPSC Interview twice.
Register: https://shorturl.at/tSmih

This mentorship session is designed for aspirants who are struggling with questions like:
Should I focus on UPSC Mains or Prelims right now?
What should I prepare over the next few months?
How do I plan my preparation based on my current level?
Why is my preparation not translating into concrete progress?

Instead of following a one-size-fits-all UPSC strategy, the session focuses on understanding your individual preparation, identifying gaps and creating a personalised UPSC roadmap.

Get guidance on UPSC CSE 2027 preparation, Mains vs Prelims strategy, study planning, mentorship, accountability, answer writing, revision and the next phase of your preparation.

Sonia Gupta Ma’am brings her experience of navigating the UPSC journey and appearing for two UPSC interviews to help aspirants approach their preparation with greater clarity and direction.

[UPSC CSE 2027 strategy | UPSC Mains vs Prelims | Personalised UPSC strategy | UPSC mentorship | UPSC preparation roadmap | UPSC study plan | UPSC answer writing | UPSC revision strategy | UPSC preparation for repeaters | UPSC accountability | UPSC guidance]
